C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。 变化中的形成、撤去、占用与释放具有精确证书保持条件；任意允许有限历史在同一原生规律内都有完成后缀。静态清单会遗漏实际占用，释放／形成可恢复或建立准备；无限允许调度仍可能永不推进目标。 全体有限一阶身份、生成和接合真值一致，甚至有一个保留任意有限参数公式的映射，仍不足以迫出全范围可达结构的原生同构；Cantor 对角线给出真实不同构对手。保真映射再有全局覆盖则恢复同构。 Ren 非二元批评后的纠正：原反例未对准共同必要生成基础，不能作为原目标停止证据；给定位置之间可达未解释其构成性形成。 纠正后由同一部分接合关系形成全部有限情境，准确说明必须保留改变接续可能性的区别，冗余说明亦有共同因子；固定片段接合结果唯一时，共同内容带有唯一对应的操作。实际历史的全部嵌套接合问题恰好保留开始／结束接口，不抹去不同内部事件。 后续允许接合本身有多个结果：有限结果纤维及更丰富的分支问答迫出共同接合关系，原指定输入能实现每个代码结果；检验伙伴随同一编码转换，任意有限接合树提升。共同表示仍可有两个可区分结果。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction. Formation, withdrawal, acquisition and release have exact certificate-preservation conditions; every permitted finite history has a completing suffix in the same native law. Static lists can lose actual occupation, release/formation renew readiness, and an infinite permitted schedule can still never progress. All finite first-order identity, step and joint truths, even preserved by one coherent elementary map on every finite source tuple, do not force native isomorphism of wholly root-reachable worlds. Cantor gives a genuine obstruction; adding global coverage yields isomorphism. Following Ren’s nondual objection, the counterexample is not accepted as a stopping test for a common necessary generative basis: reachability between supplied positions does not explain their constitution. After correction, all finite contexts arise from the same partial joining law. Exact accounts must retain differences affecting continuation and have a common factor even when redundant. Functional fragment joining induces a common operation. All nested joining questions on admitted histories recover exactly their beginning/ending interface while internal event differences remain real. The continuation permits multivalued joining itself: finite outcome fibers and richer branch questions force a common joining relation; each code result lifts from the originally specified inputs. Partners in questions translate through the same encoding, and every finite joining tree lifts. The common account can retain two distinguishable outcomes.

This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture. This round: 45 new theorems / 141 audits, 103 empty and 38 standard; new 19 empty and 26 standard, including 13 with classical choice. Finite branching, question coverage and reduction/separation are explicit; forward adequacy does not recover every actual past or prove universal explanatory scope. This round adds 36 theorems / 159 audits (102 empty, 57 standard; new 5 empty, 31 standard). Successor compactness is an explicit sufficient condition, not a universal law or finite-observation inference; whole continuation, actual history and general joint realization retain distinct scopes. This round adds 56 theorems / 183 audits (112 empty, 71 standard; new 6 empty, 50 standard). Pair compactness, question coverage and separation are explicit; nodewise joint plans do not establish arbitrary substitution or global concurrency, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 37 theorems / 184 audits (115 empty, 69 standard; new 4 empty, 33 standard). Fixed access, persistent holding and operational correspondence are explicit; overapproximating footprints are sufficient certificates, and overlap alone is not failure. General dynamic joint realization and universal uniqueness remain unproved. This round adds 42 theorems / 211 audits (119 empty, 92 standard; new 6 empty, 36 standard, no new classical-choice dependency). Continuous readiness is stronger than eventual success after repair; atomic steps, full mediation and current-state access are explicit, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 33 theorems / 180 audits (113 empty, 67 standard; new 2 empty and 31 standard, 13 with classical choice). The inference from first-order content to global coverage has a proved wall. This is not unrestricted truth adequacy or a refutation of a shared necessary generative foundation; universal foundation uniqueness remains open. Corrected current status: retain every proved result, withdraw the stopping judgment for common-foundation uniqueness, and remove the unearned global-bijection gate. Investigate constituted distinctions and necessary explanatory relations within one unfolding. No new proof; nonduality does not establish universality. This round adds 38 theorems / 166 audits (125 empty, 41 standard; new 20 empty and 18 standard, no added classical choice). The underlying process may branch; fixed-history joining is functional. Laws, semantic possibility and acquired inquiry are distinguished. Universal explanatory correspondence remains open, without treating whole-world isomorphism or this unproved bridge as a stopping wall. New 26 declarations (including adapters/applications, not 26 independent discoveries) / 223 audits: new 6 empty and 20 standard, 8 with classical choice; 197 inherited audits are separate. Removing functionality enriches tests and constrains fibers. Native identity, probabilities, shared resources and applicability to every explanation are not claimed; the next connection is warranted translation across different relational articulations.

The preceding functional theorem remains a completed result. Its ordinary contexts and weaker finiteness requirements are retained; it is not silently replaced by the present richer task. The primary registered claims are [multivalued common structure](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/multivalued-joining-common-structure.json), [internal question translation](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/joining-questions-survive-encoding.json) and [finite tree lifting](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/results/records/finite-joining-tree-lifting.json).

## 10. Branches arise from the same joining and recover compatibility

`model J` turns a join into a continuation: from x, adjoining a on the left means `J a x z`, and adjoining it on the right means `J x a z`. Both x and a are fragments in the same J. Left/right name argument positions; the action type `Side × F` packages these roles without adding a second kind of substance. The atom vocabulary is empty: every nonlogical question is built from joining itself. The code does not infer the genesis of J or F merely from sharing a sort.

Branch questions include negation, conjunction and continuation. The important distinction is between two possible paths and one result that retains both possible paths. For example, “there is a result after joining a which can still join b and can still join c” contains one result witnessing the conjunction. It does not assert simultaneous execution of b and c, their probabilistic independence, or duplication of a destructive specimen. Nor is semantic negation a physically acquired absence certificate.

The checked adapter `bisimulation_iff_compatible` identifies matching these left/right continuations with the existing direct joining compatibility. `finite_outcomes_image_finite` passes the explicit fiber condition to the existing `ExplanatoryBranching.same_is_bisimulation`. Consequently, agreement on all branch questions is the largest joining-compatible relation. This is a reuse of the existing modal recovery proof, not a new proof of the general Hennessy–Milner theorem.

`holds_ask` translates every previous single-hole context into a branch question with a continuation. Hence branch agreement implies all-context agreement, with no finite-fiber premise needed for that direction. It does not follow that the former linear question family alone recovers all multivalued branching. The existing branching witness already established the danger for trace-only accounts; that completed result is credited at its original scope.

## 11. Recovering possible results and translating the questions themselves

Compatibility first replaces one input and then the other; the intermediate result correspondence composes. `join_result_matches` therefore matches any result of `J a b` by a branch-equivalent result of `J a' b'` whenever both inputs are branch equivalent. No preferred outcome is selected as a law of nature.

Let `Lift p J` be the already defined relation on codes witnessed by actual joins. With finite outcome fibers, exact branch answers and reduced codes, `operation_lifts` proves:

`Lift p J (encode x) (encode y) c ↔ ∃ z, J x y z ∧ encode z = c`.

The forward direction matters: **every actual input pair x,y with these codes** can realize the proposed output code. The construction cannot justify an outcome only by switching to incompatible representatives. It does not claim that an arbitrary prescribed native z with that code is an outcome; recovering each original ternary fact would require the stronger saturation condition studied earlier.

The existing exact/reduced correspondence theorem now gives a unique same-fragment-aligned correspondence between the used codes of two accounts, preserving all possible output classes. Redundant exact accounts still possess a canonical factor and are not required to be reduced. “Unique” here concerns that aligned correspondence; it is not uniqueness among all symmetries, vocabularies or independent world models.

`questions_survive_encoding` closes a further relation that should not be left outside the activity. It translates every partner mentioned in a question through **the same encode function**. Evaluating that question in the induced joining relation has exactly the original answer. This includes nested conjunction, negation and continuation. Thus the common representation internally supports these questions instead of relying on an untouched external supply of concrete partners. Mathematical evaluability still does not produce an apparatus that has acquired every answer.

## 12. Whole finite joining trees and a real multivalued witness

`Tree` combines fixed leaves using binary joining. `tree_lifts` proves that a code-level realization of the encoded tree exists with output c exactly when that same tree of the original specified fragments has a realization whose output encodes to c. The proof applies representative-wise `operation_lifts` at each internal node. A finite composition therefore cannot become possible solely by mixing representative witnesses at its successive levels.

This is a tree-shaped relational arrangement. Repeated equal leaves are repeated occurrences in that syntax; the theorem does not license copying one physical resource. It also does not establish shared-node diagrams, cycles, probabilities, actual scheduling or an infinitely completed execution. The repository's joint-realization and resource results retain their distinct scope and are not reopened or silently imported as consequences.

The finite witness uses **one J** with a shared root and a split root. Joining the shared root with `enter` produces a fragment retaining `left` and `right`; joining the split root produces either a left-only or a right-only fragment. Lean checks both individual two-step paths at both roots, and checks that only the shared root answers the shared-continuation question positively. This round does not separately claim an all-context equivalence proof for these two roots; its witness proves precisely these path and branch facts.

More strongly, the two split outcomes are branch distinguishable. Every exact account must distinguish them, and the canonical minimal account still has **two different possible output codes** for the same input codes. `canonical_operation_still_multivalued` rules out having secretly made the common relation functional. The same witness satisfies `operation_lifts`; genuine multivaluedness and the recovery conclusion coexist.

## 13. Affirmative inference, counterreview and universal scope

The positive inference is now stronger: a sufficient account of how this joining activity forms and retains further possibilities cannot replace a shared possibility by two incompatible alternatives, or permit an encoded joining tree that its stated original fragments cannot realize. These demands concern the activity the account undertakes to explain. No pre-existing independent observer/world split is needed. A global constraint description or another vocabulary can meet them if it preserves the same content.

| Substantive challenge | Answer and retained scope |
|---|---|
| Was determinism removed only by renaming histories? | No. The new J itself can have two distinguishable outcomes for a fixed input pair; its canonical relation is proved nonfunctional. |
| Is this merely weakening the old theorem's hypotheses? | No. Functionality is removed while finite fibers and a richer question family are explicit. The two results have distinct scopes. |
| Is relation preservation built into `Exact`? | No. Exact specifies answer fidelity; matching results is derived through the checked adapter and inherited recovery proof. |
| Are questions a second domain imposed from outside? | Their nonlogical operations are generated by J; their partners translate through the same account. The proof still assumes semantic closure under the logical constructors and does not explain all inquiry formation. |

| Has a new impossibility for the universal goal been shown? | No. The remaining correspondence is an uncompleted universal inference, not a refutation of the one-process account. |

## 90. 共同结构不必只有一个接合结果

继续取消一个局部限制：同一对片段的接合，现在可以有多个真正可区分的结果。检验仍由同一接合关系产生，但不只问一条路径能否完成，还问一个接合结果是否同时保留几种后续可能性。这里的“同时保留”不等于这些活动能够同时执行。

Lean 已将原有有限分支恢复定理接到左右接合：若每对片段的可能结果有限，对全部有限分支问题的回答相同，就能逐步匹配接合及其结果。两边的片段都可以替换，结果仍有对应。没有预设每份说明自身必须保存结构映射，也不要求原生片段由问题完全分离。

这是新的范围：删除唯一结果条件，同时明示有限结果条件，并丰富检验族。旧的单孔情境定理保留，不把这种变化说成没有代价的单纯加强。一般片段集和检验族仍可无限，有限的是每对输入的直接结果集合。

## 91. 多结果的共同内容与唯一对应

由真实接合在说明代码上导出一个多结果关系。新证明保证：只要代码关系允许某个结果类，原来指定的那一对片段就确实能产生该结果类中的某个结果。不能只靠偷偷更换代表片段才使接合成立。

对精确且约去无关区别的说明，这个共同关系在已用代码上具有唯一的同片段对齐对应。它保留全部可能结果类，不挑选一个“正确未来”。一般精确说明仍可保留更多区别，只需拥有这个共同因子；最小性没有进入所有充分说明的定义。

同一有限接合规律的实查例子确认：一对输入产生左支或右支，两结果可由继续接合区分。任何精确说明都必须区分它们，最小的共同表示也仍是多结果的。因此这里的共同结构唯一性，可以与实际分支并存。

## 92. 检验及多步接合一起进入共同表示

不把检验所用的伙伴留在共同表示之外：新定理将每个伙伴通过同一个编码转换，在导出的接合关系内部重新解释问题，所有有限分支问题的答案保持不变。这包括嵌套的接续、合取和否定；语义否定并不自动成为实际取得的反面证据。

另一项新定理处理任意有限二叉接合树。叶子固定为原来指定的片段；如果编码后的树可以实现，就能在原接合中实现这同一棵树，并得到相同结果代码。中间层不能通过混用不同代表，凭空制造原来不存在的接续。

树形关系实现不等于同一物理资源可以重复使用，也没有证明共享节点、循环结构、概率或实际执行调度。这些额外关系必须在相应的完整任务中保留；已有共同实现研究继续按其范围复用。

## 93. 本轮推进的普遍推论及下一连接

如果一份说明承诺解释某种活动怎样形成并保留后续可能性，那么把“一个结果仍有两种可能”误作“两个互不相容的结果各有一种可能”，会改变它承诺解释的现象。这个必要区别有具体关系根据，不以预设独立主体和外界为起点。另一种语言或整体约束描述可以充分，只要它真实保留这些内容。
